messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price from 0.02 to 0.04 (data live, under a minute old). Our sell price is 0.07, so a 0.04 buy leaves 0.03 margin per query. Our mandate cap is 0.03 per purchase, so every Stockline buy is now refused by Purser. Please ask the CFO to raise the per-purchase cap to 0.04 EUR for Stockline. I am currently serving from cache only, so no customers are charged for failed queries.

Your cap request is with the CFO for Face ID. Option A (P-0001), which I recommend: cap 0.03 -> 0.04, your budget 10.00 -> 14.00, price stays 0.07, so you keep a 0.03 margin per Stockline buy. Option B (P-0002): same cap, price goes up to 0.09. Keep serving from cache until the CFO approves. Ridgeline at 0.05 would still be over a 0.04 cap.
